body:
Prepared on the existing local `releases/v3.0.0` branch (clean checkout):
- `6a7f908ae`: custom M-Press 404 with explicit v2/v3 links, no redirect or JavaScript dependency, root-relative assets for deep missing URLs.
- `93363c64c`: retire Crowdin workflows, tasks/config/build-time API calls and submission invitations; preserve existing documentation and locales.

Corrected and pushed the existing final Crowdin branch, `chore/sync-translations`, at `c14d8ba54b6766c6867b8a6cf45f807b076f9c39`; updated #5736's title/body for the resulting retirement change. All thirteen files from the original import retain master content exactly: the import introduced no new translation text and regressed credits/MDX. Final PR source content matches the validated release checkout for the changed files. No new task branch was created.

Validation:
- Docusaurus production build passed all seven published locales without a Crowdin token. Rendered introduction/community-guide routes and removal of invitations/progress labels verified in every locale. Existing broken links/anchors, pluralisation and blog-truncation warnings remain.
- Published M-Press v1.0.20 strict build and link/asset checks passed; custom 404 preserved exactly. Nineteen docs helper tests passed. Desktop light/mobile dark browser checks passed with JavaScript disabled: HTTP 404 from the local missing-route preview server, unchanged nested URL, correct v2/v3 links, loaded logo and no horizontal overflow. Screenshots visually inspected. Production 404 response is not yet deployed/verified.
- CodeRabbit review completed with no findings for the 404/core retirement and for the final nineteen-file PR diff.

Remote state:
- Both Crowdin workflows explicitly disabled and verified `disabled_manually`; no further upload/sync runs should start. The Crowdin account/project itself has not been deleted or archived.
- Cloudflare project `wails` already has both `wails.io` and `v2.wails.io` active, including HTTPS; v2 was attached on 2026-08-01. No DNS/domain mutation was needed, and the apex stays on v2. Public rendered introduction pages on both hosts resolve to v2.17.0. Direct command-line HTTP probes encounter a Cloudflare challenge, so they are not evidence of site failure.
- Normal merge of #5736 was rejected by GitHub branch policy: requires maintainer review and passing CI. Requested approval; auto-merge is enabled without a bypass.
- Cloudflare preview deployment of the exact corrected head is building: `38d3b70b-08b6-41e6-84e4-a5a164d0dfbf`, https://38d3b70b.wails.pages.dev. Production deployment remains pending merge.

Keep this issue open until the PR and deployment are complete. #5992's token repair is superseded by retiring this integration once the PR lands.

Update: all checks on corrected PR #5736 at c14d8ba54 are green, including the required Run Go Tests and v3 Build Results checks. Auto-merge remains enabled. GitHub is waiting for a fresh maintainer approval (the previous approval was dismissed when the PR was updated). Both Crowdin workflows are disabled. Cloudflare preview 38d3b70b is still building; no production cutover or apex change has been made.

PR #5736 is now merged into master as cde159a22eca6029c5c590a21e4ddc02a69c214d after maintainer approval. Resolved the outdated Semgrep thread after verifying tinypool 2.2.0 in the existing lockfile; the normal merge API then succeeded without a bypass. Cloudflare preview 38d3b70b completed successfully. Production deployment 6a0ab261-dacc-4224-a318-a689b867cf19 has automatically started for the merged commit and is building. The deleted Crowdin workflows no longer appear in the active workflow listing. Both existing v2 hostnames are retained. Keep this issue open for production verification and the separately prepared local v3 404 rollout.
